name: arjun
description: Arjun is a Telegram-based autonomous software delivery agent. Send a text or voice request such as “build a full-stack booking app” or “update the authentication flow in my existing app”; it routes the request to a new or registered project, creates a new GitHub repository when needed, plans the architecture, generates complete code, reviews it, creates its working branch, runs a remote Vercel build, promotes the verified commit to production, and returns the live URL.
